# stevo.ai — Stephen M Abbott

> Owner of Wire Hold. Cybersecurity and AI enablement consultancy. vCISO work,
> AI controls, and the occasional build. One seat for cybersecurity and AI:
> the person on the first call is the person who runs the engagement.

Stephen M Abbott is a cybersecurity and AI executive with 16 years in
enterprise technology and 11 in cybersecurity, including director-level work
at Fortune 100 scale leading a security engineering organization of up to 26
engineers. The practice runs on Arizona time and serves clients worldwide.

## Consulting packages

- vCISO retainer (monthly): part-time security executive — strategy, roadmap,
  board-ready risk, program governance, and incident readiness.
- AI enablement sprint (4–6 weeks): use-case portfolio, AI policy and control
  architecture, human approval and rollback design, agent governance.
- AI-native modernization (scoped program): operating model and workflow
  redesign, cybersecurity and IT process automation, platform roadmaps.
- Delivery sprint (scoped build): architecture and implementation of one
  approved use case — MCP servers, agent toolchains, control automation —
  handed to an internal owner.

Engagements are measured against NIST CSF 2.0, ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, CIS
Controls v8, NIST AI RMF 1.0, ISO/IEC 42001, the EU AI Act, OWASP ASVS, and
NIST SSDF. Scope and price are agreed after a first conversation; every
engagement closes with a transfer to an internal owner.
